raw_translation: Hii ni mchoro mhariri, si checker kemia. Inaunga mkono hadi ZXQPH0000QXZ hatua, ZXQPH0001QXZ mishale kwa hatua na orodha ya kipengele mdogo. Ni haitabiri majibu, kuhitimisha mishale, angalia valency au kuthibitisha kemikali plausibility. Tathmini kazi yako na kumbukumbu ya kemikali ya kuaminika. Data yako bado katika kivinjari hiki na si kuokolewa au kupakuliwa.
source: This is a diagram editor, not a chemistry checker. It supports up to 12 steps, 24 arrows per step and a limited element list. It does not predict reactions, infer arrows, check valence or validate chemical plausibility. Review your work with a trusted chemistry reference. Your data remains in this browser and is not saved or uploaded.
translation: Hii ni mchoro mhariri, si checker kemia. Inaunga mkono hadi 12 hatua, 24 mishale kwa hatua na orodha ya kipengele mdogo. Ni haitabiri majibu, kuhitimisha mishale, angalia valency au kuthibitisha kemikali plausibility. Tathmini kazi yako na kumbukumbu ya kemikali ya kuaminika. Data yako bado katika kivinjari hiki na si kuokolewa au kupakuliwa.

raw_translation: Hii ni kupitisha-na-kucheza utekelezaji wa kiwango ZXQPH0000QXZ×ZXQPH0001QXZ Reversi. Inaendeshwa katika kivinjari, anashikilia bodi katika kumbukumbu na haina kuunganisha na mchezaji mwingine au kupakia hoja.
source: This is a pass-and-play implementation of standard 8×8 Reversi. It runs in the browser, keeps the board in memory and does not connect to another player or upload moves.
translation: Hii ni kupitisha-na-kucheza utekelezaji wa kiwango 8×8 Reversi. Inaendeshwa katika kivinjari, anashikilia bodi katika kumbukumbu na haina kuunganisha na mchezaji mwingine au kupakia hoja.
